description:
List the caller's models (authenticated): `models`, the model workspaces the account holds
    (the dashboard's list: site_no, level, vpuid, status flags), and `orders`, the builds
    requested through the build queue, newest first. `limit` caps each list (default 10, max 50;
    unbounded listing used to blow the MCP result budget at ~50 builds). `active_only=True`
    returns only QUEUED/DISPATCHING/RUNNING builds. Each record carries first-class
    site_no/level/vpuid.
name: list_my_models
title: List your models and builds
